Immerse yourself in a living, meditative digital landscape. Experience the gentle ripples, watch the koi, and explore the shifting seasons of Mizunowa in real-time.

EXPLORE THE GARDEN

Four patterned koi swim through an imagined pond beneath a sakura tree, near a shrine courtyard.

SCROLL TO ENTER

01 / 錦鯉 / NISHIKIGOI

Each one leaves a different line.

Look closely and each fish has its own pattern. Their paths cross the same water at their own pace.

Click the water to feed · pick a koi to follow its line

02 / THE WALK

Three places, one slow path.

Scroll to walk the route, or pick a marker on the map to step ahead.

  1. 01池/ Ike

    Pond edge

    Begin where the koi move through the clear green water.

    NoticeFour koi, each keeping to its own line.

  2. 02桜/ Sakura

    NoticePetals resting on the water below the branches.

03 / 四季 / THE SEASONS

The garden keeps its shape. The light keeps changing.

春/ Haru

Spring

Soft blossoms gather over the water.

Pale pink sakura clusters frame the bank while stray petals drift quietly over the jade surface.

LightLow and rose-tinted

Summer 夏
Deep green leaves make a little shade. Blossoms give way to full leaf canopies and dense moss along the stepping stones, cooling the edges of the pond.
Autumn 秋
The path takes on warmer colors. Ochre foliage and warm stone tones settle along the shrine approach, echoing the gold koi moving underneath.
Winter 冬
Bare branches let the shape of the garden show. With leaves cleared away, the dark timber uprights, gabled roof, and curving stone bank read in crisp silhouette.

QUESTIONS

Notes before you begin.

Six short answers about the garden, the pond and the koi.

01Is MIZUNOWA a real place?

No. This is an imagined garden created as a digital landing-page template.

02Can I interact with the pond?

Yes. Click or touch the pond water directly to drop food and send ripples across the surface.

03What if my device cannot run the 3D scene?

A composed still view remains visible, and you can continue through the full garden guide.

04Can I pause the movement?

Yes. Rely on your device’s reduced-motion setting for a composed still view automatically.

05Are the koi real fish?

No. They are original computer-generated characters with four distinct color patterns.

06Can I book a visit?

No. The garden is fictional, and this template does not make bookings or collect personal information.
